newsitem.title: USA: MascoTech stock seen rising - BARRON'S.
newsitem.headline: MascoTech stock seen rising - BARRON'S.

text.p: Shares of MascoTech Inc are seen as undervalued by Jay Abramson, a fund manager with Cramer Rosenthal McGlynn, Barron's said Saturday.
According to the newspaper, Abramson, who has a price target for the stock of $22 to $24, expects the company to earn $1.75 a share in 1997.
Abramson anticipates that MascoTech's core business will earn $1.35 a share in 1997, with its affiliates adding another $0.40 a share, the report said.
The fund manager said in Barron's that if MascoTech were to sell its investment in its affiliates and some other ventures, it could get about $540 million, or $7.50 a share.
According to Frist Call, the mean consensus earnings estimate for the company is $1.07 a share in 1996 is and $1.55 a share in 1997.
